chrome.envDetail: Synthetic data only · no real patients · integrations are simulated
chrome.arPending: Arabic text is being prepared. Some text is shown in English for now.
chrome.compliance: Decision support for the counselor, not a diagnosis. The premarital health certificate is issued regardless of any genetic result.

search.label: Find a case by case ID
search.help: Case ID only. Searching by gene or by person is not available.
search.offShift: Go on shift to open cases.

shift.label: On shift
shift.turnedOn: You are on shift. Case data is available.
shift.turnedOff: You are off shift. Case data is hidden.

signIn.title: Counselor sign-in
signIn.description: Simulated sign-in. No real accounts exist.
signIn.shiftNote: You start off shift. Case data appears only after you go on shift.
signIn.error: Sign-in failed. Nothing was shared. You can try again.

gate.signInBody: Sign in as a counselor to see the case queue.
gate.offShiftBody: Case data is available only while you are on shift (online access). Your shift status is recorded in the audit log.
gate.expired: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.

explain.a: Trigger (a): both partners carry a change in the same gene. The couple needs a counseling appointment within the booking window.
explain.b: Trigger (b): one partner carries a change and the other screened negative. Residual risk remains, often at a technically complex locus. Confirm before any reassurance.
explain.c: Trigger (c): a variant of uncertain significance in a long run of homozygosity, a red-flag family history, or an atypical genotype. Automated clearance is suppressed.
explain.d: Trigger (d): a teach-back was not passed or SURE was below 4. A counselor talks it through.
explain.gate: A drafted message was held by the safety gate and was not sent. A counselor reviews the case.

queue.title: Queue
queue.description: Open cases, nearest 48 h target first.
queue.caption: Counselor case queue
queue.keyboard: Keyboard: j / k to move, Enter to open.
queue.saveViewTitle: Save these filters as a view
queue.emptyBody: Change the filters or pick another view.

case.title: Case {id}
case.notFoundBody: There is no case with this ID, or it is not available to you.
case.noConsentBody: This section needs active consent from both partners. The couple's data was purged when consent was withdrawn, or consent is not yet given.

brief.title: Consultation brief
brief.purged: Consent was withdrawn. The couple's data was purged; only the case shell remains.

pedigree.title: Family tree, {relationship}
pedigree.fNote: F describes the genome-wide background. It is never used on its own to counsel risk for a tested gene when molecular results exist.
pedigree.fMissing: F is shown when at least one consented record carries it.

labels.loop: Consanguinity loop: paths to shared ancestors
labels.unplaced: Position in the family not recorded

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.description: Tasks go only to the partners this case covers.
tasks.caption: Tasks for this case
tasks.outsideConsent: That task would reach someone outside the consented scope, so it was not created.
tasks.error: The task could not be saved. Nothing was sent.

tasks.cancelConsequence2: The change is recorded in the audit log.

notes.title: Notes
notes.internal: Notes are internal to the care team. They are never sent to patients.
notes.label: New note
notes.help: Up to 5,000 characters. The audit log stores the note ID, not the text.
notes.error: The note could not be saved.

actions.label: Case actions
actions.advanceHelp: The loop only moves forward. Human closure has its own action.
actions.advanceSkips: These steps will be recorded as skipped: {states}
actions.advanceError: The care loop could not be advanced.
actions.noForward: No further state is available before human closure.
actions.sureBody: Each partner answers SURE in their own app. A score below 4 opens an understanding-check case.
actions.scheduleConsequence1: Creates an appointment task for the partners this case covers.
actions.scheduleConsequence2: Records the booking against the 48 h target.
actions.scheduleConsequence3: The calendar is simulated. No real booking is made.
actions.closureHelp: Internal summary for the record. It is never sent to patients.
actions.closureConfirmTitle: Close this case as a human counselor?
actions.closureConsequence1: The couple's care loop moves to Human closure. Only a counselor can do this.
actions.closureConsequence2: Every open case for this couple is closed.
actions.closureConsequence3: Your summary is stored as an internal note and the action is audited.
actions.closureConsequence4: This cannot be undone from the workbench.
actions.closureError: The case could not be closed.
actions.closedNotice: This case is closed. Actions are no longer available.
